objectives.statement: Recognize that embedded questions use subordinate-clause word order, not direct question word order.
Build embedded wh-questions with words such as hva and hvor.
Use om for embedded yes/no questions and place ikke before the finite verb.
Use hvem som when hvem is the subject of an embedded question.

notes: Must teach indirect/embedded questions as subordinate clauses: no question inversion, sentence adverbs before the finite verb, om for embedded yes/no questions, and hvem som patterns when the wh-word is the subject.
